"If the TV settings have a VPN menu: Network & Internet → VPN → ⚙ next to Tailscale → Always-on VPN (without blocking connections without VPN).
If not — once, from a computer (USB/network debugging enabled on the TV):
adb connect TV-IP
adb shell settings put secure always_on_vpn_app com.tailscale.ipn
adb shell settings put secure always_on_vpn_lockdown 0
Tailscale then starts by itself when the TV turns on; the internet keeps working normally when your server is off."
